gloss: to jump out, to rush out

definitions.gloss: to jump out, to rush out
definitions.explanation: To suddenly emerge or exit quickly.
To extend outward from a surface.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{道|みち}に飛び出した。
examples.english: A child ran out into the road.

notes:
{飛|と}び{出|だ}す is a compound godan verb meaning "to jump out" or "to rush out." It combines {飛|と}ぶ (to jump/fly) + {出|だ}す (to come out).

TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL MOVEMENT:
- {道|みち}に{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to dash into the road
- {部屋|へや}から{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to rush out of the room

SENSE 2 - PROTRUDE:
- {目|め}が{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: eyes popping out (surprise)
- {釘|くぎ}が{飛|と}び{出|だ}している: a nail is sticking out

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {家|いえ}を{飛|と}び{出|だ}す: to leave home abruptly, to run away from home

WARNING SIGN:
「{飛|と}び{出|だ}し{注意|ちゅうい}」: Watch for children/pedestrians (common road sign in Japan)
